summary: Elemental Royalty Corp filed a Form 6-K announcing a Normal Course Issuer Bid (NCIB) to repurchase up to 3,222,537 common shares (5% of outstanding) over 12 months from June 15, 2026 to June 14, 2027. The board believes the stock is undervalued relative to its portfolio and cash flow. Purchases will be made in open market transactions on TSX, Nasdaq, and other exchanges at prevailing prices, primarily through Nasdaq. The company has no purchases in the prior 12 months. An automatic share purchase plan will allow buys during blackout periods. The plan is executed by Raymond James Ltd. and all purchased shares will be cancelled. This is a standard Canadian NCIB (equivalent to U.S. issuer tender offer rules) and provides a capital return mechanism to shareholders, with no fixed price or premium. Watch for buyback pace and impact on share count.
